dogecoin.text:
This will become the first station in Tesla's network to accept the cryptocurrency Dogecoin as payment; at this time the station is incomplete. Tesla Inc. also began accepting Doge for merchandise earlier this year.

Would you charge your Tesla with Doge? 👇
TR3NDING: Tesla plans to accept #Dogecoin at a Supercharger station in Santa Monica, California
TR3NDING: AMC plans to start accepting Dogecoin as a payment for movie tickets. https://t.co/nECs1i4ngA

AMC’s app now allows you to buy movie tickets with Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, among many others.
